ir_pool_meta.convention: hybrid ISM(order3)+RT; direct tap at t=0, direct gain 1; 200 ms; no -10 dB drop gate (the pretraining pool keeps dense tails; reflection/direct ratio stored as refl_direct_db)

excitation: decaying noise burst: tau log-uniform 3-100 ms, one-pole lowpass a~U[0,0.95], peak log-uniform [0.05,0.5] (20 dB), onset at 5 ms; used as BOTH force_waveform and the excitation convolved with a random pool IR
note: trained on the synthetic corpus (the excitation above convolved with a random pool IR) in place of ObjectFolder-Real, with the same loss, evaluation and best-model selection as train.py; the synthetic set is redrawn every epoch
